Software Engineering Intern, Backend (Summer 2027)

About the team
Our Payments Platform team builds the APIs that move money for millions of merchants.

What you'll do
- Design and build RESTful APIs and backend services in Go or Java
- Improve latency and reliability of high-throughput services; profile and optimize SQL queries in PostgreSQL
- Write unit and integration tests and ship through our CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
- Deploy containerized services with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS

Requirements
- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or similar
- Experience with at least one of: Java, Go, Python
- Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms and relational databases (SQL)
- Experience building and testing backend services

Nice to have
- Experience with Kafka or other message queues
- Familiarity with Redis caching and distributed systems
- Exposure to AWS S3, IAM, or other cloud services

Benefits
Competitive pay, health benefits, and a learning budget. We are an equal opportunity employer.
